# Sparky

> Sparky is a focused desktop coding agent for planning, editing, running, and reviewing real work across local projects.

Sparky runs locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and works with the AI provider you choose. The public website contains product information, downloads, documentation, and release notes.

Current stable release: **v1.1.47** (2026-11-17 release tag). See the [changelog](https://sparky.llc/changelog.html) for shipped updates.

## Public pages

- [Product](https://sparky.llc/): product overview and workflows.
- [Downloads](https://sparky.llc/download.html): Windows, macOS, and Linux installers.
- [Documentation](https://sparky.llc/docs/overview.html): setup, tools, models, sessions, and troubleshooting.
- [AI providers and models](https://sparky.llc/docs/models.html): account-specific model catalogs and provider setup.
- [Pull requests](https://sparky.llc/docs/pull-requests.html): GitHub reviews and individual PR actions.
- [Website previews](https://sparky.llc/docs/preview.html): local previews and browser-profile settings.
- [Sessions](https://sparky.llc/docs/sessions.html): saved conversations and steering a running thread.
- [Changelog](https://sparky.llc/changelog.html): published product updates.
- [Blog](https://sparky.llc/blog/index.html): product introductions and notes from the Sparky team and Sparky Lab, such as [Introducing Can by Sparky Lab](https://sparky.llc/blog/can.html).

## Current capabilities

- Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Fireworks, Ollama Cloud, Cerebras, and Groq. The available model catalog depends on the connected account and is shown in Settings, Models.
- Sign in to ChatGPT using device-code authorization, or use an eligible account's subscription models.
- Review GitHub pull requests with AI-generated actionable inline comments; review, merge, squash, and close actions apply to an individual selected request.
- Customize appearance with color palettes, saved themes, color mode, hover style, corner shape, and compact spacing.
- View local model usage, token totals, estimated API costs, and ChatGPT plan limits. Usage metadata stays on-device; prompts and responses are not included.
- Add streamable HTTP MCP servers; use built-in Browser and pull-request-review tools; keep browser profiles persistent or temporary.
- Split chats, focus the sidebar, steer active work, use project and user-installed skills, and coordinate agent threads across connected projects.

## Content guidance

Use the linked pages as the canonical source for current product behavior, supported platforms, and release details. The interactive demo is a no-index preview and is not a substitute for the desktop application or documentation.
